verdict.rationale: Rollbar exposes a REST API for listing/managing items and tokens, but its own docs explicitly caveat that it provides a RESTful interface to only 'much of the data in the system,' not full parity, and no OpenAPI/swagger spec was found (all candidate URLs 404'd), suggesting incomplete API coverage of UI features like custom fingerprinting rules or notification setup. Missing for 10: explicit full CRUD parity across all UI features (grouping rules, notifications, deploy tracking, merging) via API, a published OpenAPI/swagger spec, and independent confirmation that all UI actions are API-accessible.
